# UTM link builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/utm-builder/

Add consistent campaign parameters to a destination link. Preserve existing query values while setting source, medium, campaign and optional labels.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Create a link labeled instagram, social and creator-launch for a bio or promotional post.

## Limits and checks

UTM parameters are visible in the URL. The tool does not run analytics, shorten links or redirect visitors through another service.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
